items.problem: The bootstrap and validator ignored the superseded XAML deferral directive, leaving four legacy occurrences in a candidate that crashed during native XAML startup.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 1; migration-score.json reports all three features failed; session-log.txt turn 38 lists four occurrences and turns 36/46 show 0xc000027b.
items.root_cause: No migration inventory, mechanical rewrite, residue rule, or focused pattern existed for XAML deferral.
items.change: Mechanically rewrite the exact equivalent Lazy value to x:Load=False during bootstrap, reject remaining legacy directives in validation, and document realization behavior and the Window-root caveat.
items.expected_effect: Older UWP deferred elements enter WinUI 3 in the supported equivalent form without relying on agent recall.
items.falsifiable_check: A rerun produces zero x:DeferLoadStrategy matches, corresponding x:Load=False attributes remain, and the validator residue gate passes.

items.problem: SKILL.md prescribed a nonexistent winapp build command.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 2; session-log.txt turn 8 exited 1 because 'build' was not matched.
items.root_cause: The instructions conflated native compilation with packaged registration/launch.
items.change: Replace every migration build instruction with native dotnet build -p:Platform=x64 and state that winapp is only used for launch.
items.expected_effect: Agents use an available build command and produce the x64 layout expected by Test-AppLaunch.ps1 on the first attempt.
items.falsifiable_check: A rerun contains no attempted winapp build command and the first documented build exits successfully under bin\x64\Debug.

items.problem: Zero-defer migrations always triggered a deferred-file consistency warning.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 3; session-log.txt turns 36 and 46 show the warning.
items.root_cause: Bootstrap and validator used different empty-state sentinels.
items.change: Emit the validator's canonical No items deferred sentinel from the bootstrap.
items.expected_effect: The generated deferred manifest and validator agree for zero-defer migrations.
items.falsifiable_check: A bootstrap with zero deferred rows makes validation print the no-defer PASS line instead of WARN.

deferred_to_human: Consider a future Tier-1 unresolved ms-appx asset inventory for content linked from sibling SharedContent trees; it was lower leverage than the three applied items.
